test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 50 identical units are purchased at a total price of Rs. 550 and (1)/(5) of these units are sold at a loss of 10%. Find the per unit selling price of the remaining units to gain 20% on the whole transaction.
solution:
**Given:**

Total units purchased = 50

Total price = Rs. 550

Loss on 1/5th units = 10%

Gain on whole transaction = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Cost Price (CP) per unit = Total price / Total units

Selling Price (SP) of 1/5th units at 10% loss = CP - (10% of CP)

Total selling price of remaining units to gain 20% = Total cost + 20% of Total cost
